title: Canadian Software Procurement Notice Dataset
subtitle: 136 privacy-filtered Canadian public software procurement notices with documented selection and requirement signals
description: Essential Designs parsed 16,203 official CanadaBuys tender-notice rows across three fiscal years and released 136 notices selected through a documented rule-based classifier and complete review of all lower-confidence candidates. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada. The derivative release does not suggest Government of Canada endorsement.

resources.description: The public tabular release with 136 qualified notices and derived requirement-mention fields.
The same 136 qualified records in JSON format.
Aggregate counts, categories, notice types, and requirement signals.
Official source URLs, source row counts, file sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.
